paragraphs: Hyman mentions him in Midrash Tehillim 137:3, but reports that Pesikta Rabbati, chapter 26, has Rabbi Tachlifa bar Keruya.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Ilfi bar Keruya and Tachlifa bar Keruya are the differing names attributed to Midrash Tehillim and Pesikta Rabbati.

The whole OYW Midrash Tehillim 137 scalar writes the abbreviated R' Alfa bar Keruya (אלפא בר קרויא), while the whole OYW Pesikta Rabbati 28 scalar fully writes Rabbi Tachlifa bar Keruya. Hyman’s Ilfi form, Midrash Tehillim 137:3 and Pesikta chapter 26 are retained alongside these actual digital locations; no printed-numbering repair or identity harmonization is made. The heading retains R' because the first digital title is abbreviated. The current note remains verbatim; the earlier failed subsection lookup remains a historical failure, not source evidence.
